title: Nonlinear type and metric embeddings of lamplighter spaces
summary: We prove that for all metric spaces $X$ the following properties of the lamplighter space $\mathsf{La}(X)$ are equivalent: (1) every snowflake of $\mathsf{La}(X)$ admits a biLipschitz embedding into a finite product of $\mathbb{R}$-trees, (2) every snowflake of $\mathsf{La}(X)$ admits a biLipschitz embedding into a Hilbert space, (3) $\mathsf{La}(X)$ has finite Nagata dimension, (4) $\mathsf{La}(X)$ has Markov type 2, (5) $\mathsf{La}(X)$ has nontrivial Enflo type, (6) $\mathsf{La}(X)$ does not contain the Hamming cubes with uniform distortion.
